name: procedural-memory
context: Long-horizon agents that must acquire, store, and reuse executable skills across tasks. After completing a task or task type, the agent extracts a reusable procedure (e.g., a Python function or shell script) and stores it in a skill library. Future tasks that match the skill's preconditions retrieve and execute the stored procedure directly rather than recomputing from scratch. Unlike scratchpad-note-taking (working memory for the current task), procedural memory stores reusable, executable artifacts that persist across sessions.
benefits: Compounds agent capabilities over time without retraining
Reduces cost and latency on repeated task patterns
Alleviates catastrophic forgetting in long-running agents
Skills are interpretable and debuggable executable code
tradeoffs: Skill extraction requires an LLM call per skill
Precondition matching is non-trivial (what task fits which skill?)
Stored skills may become stale as the environment evolves
use_cases: Coding agents that learn reusable functions across tasks
Autonomous agents in game environments (Minecraft Voyager-style)
DevOps agents that build reusable runbook scripts
Research agents that extract reusable experiment protocols
avoid_when: Tasks are unique and never repeat
Skills require physical world interaction to validate
Environment changes too fast for stored procedures to remain valid
anti_patterns: No skill staleness check before reuse
Matching purely on lexical similarity rather than semantic preconditions
design_principles: Extract skills only after successful task completion
Validate extracted skills against a test case before storing
Index skills by both description embedding and input/output schema
best_practices: Store skills as executable code with docstrings and type hints
Test each new skill against a golden validation case before committing
Set a skill library size cap and evict rarely-used skills
references: Wang et al., Voyager: An Open-Ended Embodied Agent with Large Language Models, 2023 — https://arxiv.org/abs/2305.16291
